name: Hemo Organic Limited
about: Hemo Organic Limited buys, sells, resells, imports, exports, transports, stores, develops, promotes, supplies, markets, and deals agricultural products in India and internationally. It trades in wheat, rice, and maize; vegetables, including capsicum, tomato, green chili, potato, cucumber, and onion; and fruits, such as apple, red dragon fruit, sweet lime, and pomegranate. The company was formerly known as Dinesh Allorga Limited and changed its name to Hemo Organic Limited in August 2013. The company is based in Ahmedabad, India.
